takeaways: Manually assembled GRC reports are slow, error-prone and outdated by the time auditors or leadership see them.
Power Automate connects SharePoint evidence, Excel risk registers and Dataverse incident logs, standardizes the data and builds draft reports automatically.
Once the flows run, conditional reports, automated escalations and live Power BI dashboards turn compliance reporting into continuous, strategic governance.
hook: Compliance teams still lose weeks stitching GRC reports together from spreadsheets, SharePoint folders and incident logs, and the result is often stale or wrong. This episode is for compliance, risk and Power Platform professionals who want reliable, auditable reporting. You will learn how to build a Power Automate pipeline that collects, standardizes and reports GRC data automatically.
